# About us

Mission

Multiplier is on a mission to bridge the AI adoption gap in professional services by partnering with the best customer-focused firms and deploying custom AI technology to scale the number of clients they can serve, elevate the experience for clients and staff and increase the impact they have on their industry.

MULTIPLIER

Our Principles

01

Premium Service

We are nothing without our customers. The most important principle in our business is a relentless focus on serving our clients well. We deliver quality work and excellent customer service. We never reach for efficiencies where it would come at the expense of work quality or client satisfaction.

02

Alignment

When we buy a business we invest to grow it quickly while improving both client experience and cost through technology. We share this upside with the firm operators and staff. We believe technology can deliver abundance where clients, owners, staff, and investors can all reap rewards.

03

Autonomy

We operate a global network of diverse businesses. Success is contingent upon having the right leaders whose desire for freedom, prosperity, and doing right by their people creates great outcomes with minimal central overhead.

04

Optimism

Anything is possible — we sit at the beginning of an infinite curve of human progress and we must simply work hard to move ourselves forward each day.

05

Curiosity

There is no substitute for genuine curiosity — the unquenched desire to better understand people, technologies, and systems. Cultivating genuine curiosity leads to joy in work, success in business, and a healthy mind.
